blocks.home.faq.whatIs.question: What is One Platform?
blocks.home.faq.whatIs.answer: One account your business sells from, takes card payments through, issues its invoices with, dispatches its deliveries from and publishes its content on — from one dashboard, or through one REST API if you are building your own product.
blocks.home.faq.technical.question: Do I need to be technical to use it?
blocks.home.faq.technical.answer: No. You build your store, load your products and start taking payments from the dashboard, without writing a line of code. The API is there for whoever wants it, not for whoever wants to sell.
blocks.home.faq.integrate.question: Can I integrate it into my own product?
blocks.home.faq.integrate.answer: Yes. Everything the dashboard does is exposed through the REST API, with two-token authentication and webhooks — and the whitelabel dashboard can run under your own brand.

blocks.home.faq.whatIs.question: ¿Qué es One Platform?
blocks.home.faq.whatIs.answer: Una sola cuenta desde la que tu comercio vende, cobra con tarjeta, emite sus facturas, despacha sus entregas y publica su contenido — desde un panel, o con una sola API REST si construyes tu propio producto.
blocks.home.faq.technical.question: ¿Necesito saber de tecnología para usarlo?

blocks.home.faq.integrate.question: ¿Puedo integrarlo en mi propio producto?

blocks.about.title: About 1Platform Labs — One Platform for Online Business
blocks.about.description: Learn about 1Platform Labs and our mission to make online stores, websites, payments, AI content, and a developer-grade API available from a single platform.
blocks.about.hero.headline: About 1Platform Labs
blocks.about.hero.subheadline: We build one platform for selling, growing and integrating online — instead of stitching separate services together and calling it a stack.
blocks.about.mission.p1: 1Platform Labs was founded on a simple observation: businesses spend more time managing their tools than using them. Running a modern online business usually means juggling a storefront, a payment processor, an invoicing system, a website builder, a content platform and a separate developer API — each with its own login, billing, data format and learning curve.
blocks.about.mission.p2: We set out to build something different. A single platform that brings online stores, websites, AI content, whitelabel dashboards, payments, electronic invoicing and a developer-grade REST API into one connected system. From the first product you sell to the last invoice you issue, every capability works through the same API.
blocks.about.fragmentation.lead: What a fragmented stack actually costs you
blocks.about.fragmentation.note: Every disconnected tool in the stack takes time and attention. Data gets lost between services, workflows break at the integration points, and teams spend their days moving records by hand instead of doing the work.
blocks.about.fragmentation.row1.without: A separate service to subscribe to, log into and renew
blocks.about.fragmentation.row1.with: One platform, one token pair, one dashboard
blocks.about.fragmentation.row2.without: Data exported and re-imported by hand between tools
blocks.about.fragmentation.row3.without: A different API, auth model and error format to learn per tool
blocks.about.fragmentation.row3.with: One REST API with a single reference
blocks.about.fragmentation.row4.without: Billing and cost tracking scattered across vendors
blocks.about.fragmentation.row4.with: A single bill for everything you use
blocks.about.fragmentation.row5.without: No single view of how the business is actually doing
blocks.about.capabilities.lead: Every capability, reachable through one API
blocks.about.capabilities.docsLink: See how they are exposed in the API
blocks.about.team.p1: 1Platform Labs is a team of engineers, designers and operators who got tired of the fragmentation problem. We build the platform we always wished existed: developer-first, API-native, and relentlessly focused on removing complexity rather than adding surface.
blocks.about.team.p2: We are committed to building tools that are accessible, affordable and powerful enough for any scale of operation.

blocks.about.title: Nosotros — 1Platform Labs, una sola plataforma para tu negocio online
blocks.about.description: Conoce 1Platform Labs y nuestra misión: reunir tiendas online, sitios web, pagos, contenido con IA y una API de nivel profesional en una sola plataforma.
blocks.about.hero.headline: Nosotros: 1Platform Labs
blocks.about.hero.subheadline: Construimos una sola plataforma para vender, crecer e integrar por internet — en lugar de coser servicios sueltos y llamarlo un stack.
blocks.about.mission.p1: 1Platform Labs nació de una observación simple: las empresas pasan más tiempo administrando sus herramientas que usándolas. Llevar un negocio online moderno suele implicar hacer malabares con una tienda, un procesador de pagos, un sistema de facturación, un creador de sitios web, una plataforma de contenido y una API de desarrollador aparte — cada una con su propio inicio de sesión, facturación, formato de datos y curva de aprendizaje.
blocks.about.mission.p2: Nos propusimos construir algo distinto. Una sola plataforma que reúne tiendas online, sitios web, contenido con IA, paneles de marca blanca, pagos, facturación electrónica y una API REST de nivel profesional en un solo sistema conectado. Desde el primer producto que vendes hasta la última factura que emites, cada función pasa por la misma API.
blocks.about.fragmentation.lead: Lo que un stack fragmentado realmente te cuesta
blocks.about.fragmentation.note: Cada herramienta desconectada del stack consume tiempo y atención. Los datos se pierden entre servicios, los flujos de trabajo se rompen en los puntos de integración y los equipos pasan el día moviendo registros a mano en vez de hacer el trabajo.

blocks.about.fragmentation.row1.with: Una plataforma, un par de tokens, un panel
blocks.about.fragmentation.row2.without: Datos exportados e importados a mano entre herramientas

blocks.about.fragmentation.row4.without: Facturación y control de costos repartidos entre proveedores
blocks.about.fragmentation.row4.with: Una sola factura por todo lo que usas
blocks.about.fragmentation.row5.without: Ninguna vista única de cómo va realmente el negocio
blocks.about.fragmentation.row5.with: Visibilidad de punta a punta en un solo lugar
blocks.about.capabilities.lead: Cada función, disponible a través de una sola API
blocks.about.capabilities.docsLink: Mira cómo se exponen en la API
blocks.about.team.p1: 1Platform Labs es un equipo de ingenieros, diseñadores y operadores cansados del problema de la fragmentación. Construimos la plataforma que siempre quisimos que existiera: centrada en el desarrollador, nativa de API y enfocada sin descanso en quitar complejidad en vez de sumar superficie.
blocks.about.team.p2: Estamos comprometidos a construir herramientas accesibles, asequibles y suficientemente potentes para cualquier escala de operación.

blocks.paymentsInvoicing.title: Accept Payments & Issue Electronic Invoices | One Platform
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.description: Accept online card payments and issue compliant electronic invoices automatically — all from one platform. Webhook-driven, audit-ready, ready for production.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.hero.headline: Payments and compliant invoicing
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.hero.subheadline: Accept payments and issue compliant electronic invoices automatically — from one platform. Webhook-driven, audit-ready, production-tested.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.whatYouGet.lead: From checkout to compliant invoice, on one platform
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.capability.acceptPayme: Card payments via API. Hosted checkout URLs, real-time webhooks and automatic balance crediting.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.capability.issueInvoic: Compliant electronic invoices generated automatically. PDF + XML output, multi-item lines, automatic tax calculation.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.waysToCharge.lead: Not every sale arrives through your checkout. These are the other ways money reaches you.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.charge.link.title: Send a payment link
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.charge.link.descriptio: Emit a link and send it to whoever owes you. The person paying does not need a One Platform account and never signs in: the link opens straight into a hosted checkout. You can list your links, look one up, and cancel one that should no longer be paid.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.charge.link.note: A link that has already been paid, cancelled or expired shows a short status page instead of taking money again.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.charge.terminal.title: Take cards in person
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.charge.terminal.descri: Apply for a card terminal for a business, attach the documents it asks for, send the application, and follow where it is. If something needs fixing you can correct it, and you can withdraw it while it is still open.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.charge.terminal.prereq: It is an application, not an instant activation. Before you can open one, the business needs its tax identification and electronic invoicing already working, or the request comes back listing exactly what is missing. Only a branch administrator can file it, and the answer can be a rejection.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.charge.subscriptions.d: Build your own plans, publish them, and enrol your customers on them. Keep the customer records, read the subscriptions back, and cancel one when someone leaves. Your plans, your customers, your recurring revenue.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.charge.subscriptions.n: An invitation enrols one customer once. To bring in someone else, or the same person again after theirs is used, issue another. This is separate from the balance you hold with One Platform.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.capability.trackEveryt: HMAC-signed webhooks for every lifecycle event. Activity logs with method, endpoint, status and latency.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.outcomes.title: Create a transaction, get an invoice
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.outcomes.body: One call opens the checkout. When the payment settles, the invoice is issued from the same transaction — no second system to reconcile it against, no export in between.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.questions.lead: What people ask before they switch
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.faq.countries.q: Which countries are supported for electronic invoicing?
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.faq.countries.a: Electronic invoicing currently issues compliant invoices for Guatemala (FEL). Additional jurisdictions are on the roadmap — write to us for timelines.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.faq.currencies.q: What currencies and payment methods do you accept?
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.faq.currencies.a: We accept all major credit and debit cards. Settlement currency is configured per merchant — write to us to enable additional currencies.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.faq.invoiceTypes.q: What types of invoices can I issue?
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.faq.invoiceTypes.a: Standard invoices, credit notes, and cancellations — all PDF + XML output. Multi-item line support and automatic tax calculation.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.faq.reconciliation.a: Every transaction emits HMAC-signed webhooks for approved, denied, cancelled, expired, and dismissed states. Pair with activity logs for full audit trails.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.related.lead: Payments and invoicing connect with the rest of the platform
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.related.onlineStore.de: Add a full storefront with checkout and customer accounts.
Integrate payments and invoicing into your own SaaS via REST.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.related.whitelabel.des: Surface payments and invoicing under your own brand.

blocks.paymentsInvoicing.title: Acepta pagos y emite facturas electrónicas | One Platform
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.description: Acepta pagos con tarjeta y emite facturas electrónicas conformes de forma automática — todo desde una sola plataforma. Impulsado por webhooks, listo para auditoría y para producción.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.hero.headline: Pagos y facturación conforme
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.hero.subheadline: Acepta pagos y emite facturas electrónicas conformes de forma automática — desde una sola plataforma. Impulsado por webhooks, listo para auditoría, probado en producción.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.whatYouGet.lead: Del checkout a la factura conforme, en una sola plataforma
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.capability.acceptPayme: Pagos con tarjeta vía API. URLs de checkout alojadas, webhooks en tiempo real y acreditación automática de saldo.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.capability.issueInvoic: Facturas electrónicas conformes, generadas automáticamente. Salida en PDF y XML, múltiples líneas por factura y cálculo automático de impuestos.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.waysToCharge.lead: No toda venta entra por tu checkout. Estas son las otras formas en que el dinero te llega.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.charge.link.title: Manda un enlace de cobro
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.charge.link.descriptio: Emite un enlace y mándaselo a quien te debe. Quien paga no necesita una cuenta de One Platform y nunca inicia sesión: el enlace abre directo en un checkout alojado. Puedes listar tus enlaces, consultar uno y cancelar el que ya no deba pagarse.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.charge.link.note: Un enlace ya pagado, cancelado o vencido muestra una página de estado breve en lugar de volver a cobrar.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.charge.terminal.title: Cobra con tarjeta presente
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.charge.terminal.descri: Solicita una terminal para un comercio, adjunta los documentos que pide, envía la solicitud y sigue en qué punto está. Si algo hay que corregir puedes hacerlo, y puedes retirarla mientras siga abierta.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.charge.terminal.prereq: Es una solicitud, no un alta inmediata. Antes de poder abrirla, el comercio necesita su identificación tributaria y la facturación electrónica ya funcionando, o la solicitud vuelve enumerando exactamente lo que falta. Sólo un administrador de sucursal puede presentarla, y la respuesta puede ser un rechazo.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.charge.subscriptions.t: Cóbrale cada mes a tus clientes
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.charge.subscriptions.d: Arma tus propios planes, publícalos y da de alta en ellos a tus clientes. Guarda las fichas de cliente, consulta las suscripciones y cancela una cuando alguien se va. Tus planes, tus clientes, tus ingresos recurrentes.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.charge.subscriptions.n: Una invitación da de alta a un cliente una vez. Para sumar a otra persona, o a la misma después de que use la suya, emite otra. Esto es distinto del saldo que tú tienes con One Platform.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.capability.trackEveryt: Webhooks firmados con HMAC para cada evento del ciclo de vida. Registros de actividad con método, endpoint, estado y latencia.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.outcomes.title: Crea una transacción, obtén una factura
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.outcomes.body: Una sola llamada abre el checkout. Cuando el pago se liquida, la factura se emite desde esa misma transacción — sin un segundo sistema que conciliar, sin exportación de por medio.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.questions.lead: Lo que preguntan antes de dar el salto
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.faq.countries.q: ¿Para qué países está disponible la facturación electrónica?
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.faq.countries.a: Hoy la facturación electrónica emite facturas conformes para Guatemala (FEL). Más jurisdicciones están en el roadmap — escríbenos para conocer los plazos.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.faq.currencies.q: ¿Qué monedas y métodos de pago aceptan?
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.faq.currencies.a: Aceptamos las principales tarjetas de crédito y débito. La moneda de liquidación se configura por comercio — escríbenos para habilitar monedas adicionales.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.faq.invoiceTypes.a: Facturas estándar, notas de crédito y anulaciones — todas en PDF y XML. Soporta múltiples líneas por factura y calcula los impuestos automáticamente.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.faq.reconciliation.a: Cada transacción emite webhooks firmados con HMAC para los estados approved, denied, cancelled, expired y dismissed. Combínalos con los registros de actividad para una auditoría completa.
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.related.lead: Pagos y facturación se conectan con el resto de la plataforma
blocks.paymentsInvoicing.related.onlineStore.de: Suma una tienda completa con checkout y cuentas de cliente.
Integra pagos y facturación en tu propio SaaS vía REST.

blocks.pricing.model.bounded.body: A prepaid balance cannot be overspent. You are notified as it runs low, and operations stop rather than accruing a bill you never agreed to.

blocks.pricing.faq.lead: The rest of what people ask before they start.
blocks.pricing.faq.howPricingWorks.question: How does pricing work?
blocks.pricing.faq.howPricingWorks.answer: There is no subscription. Your account holds a prepaid balance in USD, and every billable operation draws from it at a per-unit rate. You activate whichever solutions you need and pay for the operations you actually run.
blocks.pricing.faq.whyRatesHidden.question: Why are per-unit rates not listed on this page?
blocks.pricing.faq.whyRatesHidden.answer: Rates are set per account rather than published as one list, because they move with volume and with the country you operate in. The unit each operation is billed by is fixed and listed above — the rate attached to each unit comes on your rate card.
blocks.pricing.faq.freePlan.question: Is there a free plan?
blocks.pricing.faq.freePlan.answer: Yes. Create an account with no credit card and you get a daily allowance for content generation and keyword extraction, plus full REST API access. When you need more than the daily allowance, add balance — nothing about how you build changes.
blocks.pricing.faq.operationFails.question: What happens if an operation fails?
blocks.pricing.faq.operationFails.answer: Nothing is charged. The cost is held against your balance before the work starts and captured only once the operation completes. If it fails, the hold is released and your balance is untouched. Retries carry an idempotency key, so a repeated call is never charged twice.
blocks.pricing.faq.unexpectedBill.question: Can I end up with a bill I did not expect?
blocks.pricing.faq.unexpectedBill.answer: No. Because the balance is prepaid, you cannot spend past it. You get a low-balance notification as it runs down, and once it is insufficient the affected operations stop rather than accruing a debt. Every charge is itemised in your consumption log with the operation, the endpoint, the cost, and your balance before and after.
blocks.pricing.faq.volumeDiscount.question: Do rates improve with volume?
blocks.pricing.faq.volumeDiscount.answer: Yes. Per-unit rates are configured per account, so sustained volume is reflected in your rate card. Tell us the operations you expect to run and we will quote against them.
blocks.pricing.faq.paymentMethods.question: What payment methods do you accept?
blocks.pricing.faq.paymentMethods.answer: Credit and debit cards, charged through the same hosted checkout the platform gives you for your own customers. For larger accounts we can arrange billing terms and consolidated invoicing.

blocks.pricing.faq.howPricingWorks.question: ¿Cómo funcionan los precios?

blocks.pricing.faq.whyRatesHidden.question: ¿Por qué las tarifas por unidad no aparecen en esta página?
blocks.pricing.faq.whyRatesHidden.answer: Las tarifas se definen por cuenta en lugar de publicarse en una sola lista, porque varían según el volumen y el país donde operas. La unidad con la que se factura cada operación es fija y está listada arriba; la tarifa asignada a cada unidad viene en tu tarifario.
blocks.pricing.faq.freePlan.question: ¿Hay un plan gratuito?
blocks.pricing.faq.freePlan.answer: Sí. Crea una cuenta sin tarjeta de crédito y obtienes una cuota diaria para generación de contenido y extracción de palabras clave, además de acceso completo a la API REST. Cuando necesites más que la cuota diaria, añade saldo: nada cambia en tu forma de construir.
blocks.pricing.faq.operationFails.question: ¿Qué pasa si una operación falla?
blocks.pricing.faq.operationFails.answer: No se cobra nada. El costo se retiene contra tu saldo antes de que el trabajo empiece y se captura solo cuando la operación se completa. Si falla, la retención se libera y tu saldo queda intacto. Los reintentos llevan una clave de idempotencia, así que una llamada repetida nunca se cobra dos veces.
blocks.pricing.faq.unexpectedBill.question: ¿Puedo terminar con una factura que no esperaba?

Recibes un aviso de saldo bajo a medida que se agota, y cuando ya no alcanza, las operaciones afectadas se detienen en lugar de generar una deuda. Cada cobro queda detallado en tu registro de consumo con la operación, el endpoint, el costo, y tu saldo antes y después.
blocks.pricing.faq.volumeDiscount.question: ¿Las tarifas mejoran con el volumen?

blocks.pricing.faq.paymentMethods.question: ¿Qué métodos de pago aceptan?
